AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

  # ---------------- Frontend ----------------
  FrontendApp:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::App
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      Repository: !Ref GitHubRepo
      AccessToken: !Ref AmplifyAccessToken
      EnvironmentVariables:
        API_URL: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
      BuildSpec: |
        version: 1
        frontend:
          phases:
            preBuild:
              commands:
                - echo "window.PROCESSPATCH_API=\"${API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}\";" > frontend/config.js
            build:
              commands: []
          artifacts:
            baseDirectory: frontend
            files:
              - '**/*'
          cache:
            paths: []

  FrontendBranch:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::Branch
    Properties:
      AppId: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId
      BranchName: !Ref AmplifyBranch
      EnableAutoBuild: true

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

  # ---------------- Frontend ----------------
  FrontendApp:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::App
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      Repository: !Ref GitHubRepo
      AccessToken: !Ref AmplifyAccessToken
      EnvironmentVariables:
        - Name: API_URL
          Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
      BuildSpec: |
        version: 1
        frontend:
          phases:
            preBuild:
              commands:
                - echo "window.PROCESSPATCH_API=\"${API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}\";" > frontend/config.js
            build:
              commands: []
          artifacts:
            baseDirectory: frontend
            files:
              - '**/*'
          cache:
            paths: []

  FrontendBranch:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::Branch
    Properties:
      AppId: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId
      BranchName: !Ref AmplifyBranch
      EnableAutoBuild: true

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
  RegistryTable:
    Value: !Ref RegistryTable
  SourceBucket:
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  DashboardName:
    Value: !Ref Dashboard
  AmplifyAppId:
    Value: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId

The latest failure was caused by an invalid Amplify property format:

```yaml
EnvironmentVariables:
  API_URL: ...
```

AWS requires:

```yaml
EnvironmentVariables:
  - Name: API_URL
    Value: ...
```

That is now fixed.

Also fixed:

- CloudFormation circular dependency
- Dashboard `Fn::Sub` issue
- SAM S3 packaging
- Python 3.12 dependency packaging
- PowerShell script continuing after failed deployment

Validation now passes:

- SAM build
- SAM lint
- CloudFormation validation
- Infrastructure validation
- PowerShell syntax validation

Retry:

```powershell
$python312 = "C:\Users\ayush\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312"
$env:Path = "$python312;$python312\Scripts;$env:Path"

$env:AWS_PROFILE = "processpatch"
$env:AWS_REGION = "ap-south-1"
$env:AWS_DEFAULT_REGION = "ap-south-1"

aws sts get-caller-identity

.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

This time, if SAM fails, the script will stop at the actual SAM error and will not produce the misleading `-Api` message.

If AWS reports that the stack is stuck in `REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS`, remove the failed empty stack first:

```powershell
aws cloudformation delete-stack `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch

aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

Then rerun the deployment command.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:

The deployment progressed successfully until `FrontendApp`. The failure is:

```text
GitHub API: 404 Not Found
```

The repository URL currently configured is:

```text
https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds.git
```

That URL returns `404`, so Amplify cannot access it. The `-Api` parameter is unrelated.

## Fix GitHub access

Check these items:

1. Confirm the repository exists at:

   `https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds`

2. If the repository is private, your GitHub token must have access to that exact repository.
3. For a fine-grained token:
   - Repository owner: `Stakeylock`
   - Repository access: select `Bharatbuilds`
   - Repository permissions:
     - `Contents`: Read-only
     - `Metadata`: Read-only
4. Make sure the token belongs to the GitHub account that can access the repository.
5. If the repository was renamed or moved, update

.

Test your token locally without printing it:

```powershell
$headers = @{
  Authorization = "Bearer $env:AMPLIFY_TOKEN"
  Accept = "application/vnd.github+json"
}

$r = Invoke-WebRequest `
  -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds" `
  -Headers $headers `
  -SkipHttpErrorCheck

$r.StatusCode
```

Expected result:

```text
200
```

Results mean:

- `200`: repository and token access are correct.
- `404`: wrong repository URL or token cannot access it.
- `401`: token is invalid or expired.

## After fixing the token

Set it again in the same PowerShell window:

```powershell
$env:AMPLIFY_TOKEN = "your-github-token"
```

Delete the failed stack:

```powershell
aws cloudformation delete-stack `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch

aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

Then retry:

```powershell
.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

The AWS backend resources were created correctly before Amplify failed. They were rolled back because the stack is atomic, so the next attempt will recreate them after GitHub access is fixed.

toolCallRounds.response:
The deployment progressed successfully until `FrontendApp`. The failure is:

```text
GitHub API: 404 Not Found
```

The repository URL currently configured is:

```text
https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds.git
```

That URL returns `404`, so Amplify cannot access it. The `-Api` parameter is unrelated.

## Fix GitHub access

Check these items:

1. Confirm the repository exists at:

   `https://github.com/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds`

2. If the repository is private, your GitHub token must have access to that exact repository.
3. For a fine-grained token:
   - Repository owner: `Stakeylock`
   - Repository access: select `Bharatbuilds`
   - Repository permissions:
     - `Contents`: Read-only
     - `Metadata`: Read-only
4. Make sure the token belongs to the GitHub account that can access the repository.
5. If the repository was renamed or moved, update `infra/parameters.json`.

Test your token locally without printing it:

```powershell
$headers = @{
  Authorization = "Bearer $env:AMPLIFY_TOKEN"
  Accept = "application/vnd.github+json"
}

$r = Invoke-WebRequest `
  -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Stakeylock/Bharatbuilds" `
  -Headers $headers `
  -SkipHttpErrorCheck

$r.StatusCode
```

Expected result:

```text
200
```

Results mean:

- `200`: repository and token access are correct.
- `404`: wrong repository URL or token cannot access it.
- `401`: token is invalid or expired.

## After fixing the token

Set it again in the same PowerShell window:

```powershell
$env:AMPLIFY_TOKEN = "your-github-token"
```

Delete the failed stack:

```powershell
aws cloudformation delete-stack `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch

aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete `
  --stack-name processpatch-demo `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

Then retry:

```powershell
.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

The AWS backend resources were created correctly before Amplify failed. They were rolled back because the stack is atomic, so the next attempt will recreate them after GitHub access is fixed.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharathbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

  # ---------------- Frontend ----------------
  FrontendApp:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::App
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      Repository: !Ref GitHubRepo
      AccessToken: !Ref AmplifyAccessToken
      EnvironmentVariables:
        - Name: API_URL
          Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
      BuildSpec: |
        version: 1
        frontend:
          phases:
            preBuild:
              commands:
                - echo "window.PROCESSPATCH_API=\"${API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}\";" > frontend/config.js
            build:
              commands: []
          artifacts:
            baseDirectory: frontend
            files:
              - '**/*'
          cache:
            paths: []

  FrontendBranch:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::Branch
    Properties:
      AppId: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId
      BranchName: !Ref AmplifyBranch
      EnableAutoBuild: true

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
  RegistryTable:
    Value: !Ref RegistryTable
  SourceBucket:
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  DashboardName:
    Value: !Ref Dashboard

    Value: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId

# **A policy changed. Which procedure steps are wrong now?**

![ci](https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharathbuilds/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)

> Policies are source code. Procedures are compiled artifacts. Amendments are commits.
> ProcessPatch finds the people or cases that prove a procedure is stale, patches the affected logic, reruns regression tests, and requires human approval of exact artifact hashes before anything changes.

```
Policy change
     ↓
Compile (+ rule review)
     ↓
Witness ("who gets the wrong outcome?")
     ↓
Impact (blast radius from evidence, never estimates)
     ↓
Localized patch
     ↓
Regression tests
     ↓
Certificate → Human approval → New procedure version
```

**Canonical example (synthetic university research grant):** Policy V2 relaxes CGPA
8.0 → 7.5 and makes recommendation required only when CGPA < 8.0. The stale portal
still enforces V1. ProcessPatch returns witness A (CGPA 7.80: expected ELIGIBLE,
portal INELIGIBLE) and witness B (CGPA 8.20: expected rec SKIP, portal REQUIRE),
localizes `NODE-GATE` + `NODE-STEP`, proposes a localized patch, validates 16/16
(witnesses, boundaries, unchanged, ordering, integrity, metamorphic, provenance), quantifies
impact over a 100-case generated cohort, and mints a source-linked certificate.
A second domain (reimbursement: tightened limit, conditional approval, ordering,
deadline) validates 20/20.

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"        # pytest + pyyaml (clean-machine repro)
python scripts/verify.py        # 176 assertions, no network/LLM/AWS
make verify                     # same
make benchmark                  # ProcessPatchBench v0.2.0, 29 scenarios
make infra-validate             # SAM/ASL/dashboard checks, no credentials
python scripts/demo.py          # terminal person-first demo
python -m services.api.server 8000   # REST API (§45 + §57E)
# open frontend/index.html → COMPILE AMENDMENT
```

API highlights: `GET /demo/canonical`, `POST /builds` (idempotent),
`GET /builds/{id}/{diff,witnesses,patch,certificate,impact,guardrails,audit}`,
rule review `POST .../rules/{rid}/{accept,edit,reject,escalate}`,
`POST .../patch/{approve,reject,request-revision}`, witness replay,
`POST /procedures/{v}/activate` (hash-verified), `POST /builds/{id}/resume`
(server-side Step Functions resume — clients never hold task tokens),
benchmark endpoints. The local server and the Lambda `ApiFn` share one
implementation (`services/api/actions.py`) so both surfaces stay identical.

## Layout

`services/` deterministic pipeline + impact/governance/registry/bench/aws_handlers ·
`shared/schemas/` all contracts · `demo/` two domains · `frontend/` 11-tab UI ·
`benchmark/processpatchbench/` 29 heterogeneous cases + manifest ·
`benchmark_runs/` reference runs · `tests/` 8 suites · `infra/` full SAM setup ·
`docs/` 12 notes · `scripts/` verify/demo/benchmark/smoke/infra-validate.

## Trust

A deterministic parser extracts the bounded rule language into typed candidates
with source spans; a Bedrock model fallback engages only when the parser yields
nothing usable (and is schema-validated + Gate-1 reviewed like everything
else). Deterministic code decides correctness. Humans approve exact hashes. Ambiguity → NEEDS_REVIEW, conflict →
COMPILATION BLOCKED. Patches are VALIDATED_WITHIN_TESTED_MODEL, never
"compliance guaranteed".

> Software gets regression tests when code changes. Real-world procedures should get them when rules change.

{

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharathbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:

  BuildStateMachine:

    Properties:

        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule

      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-

        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope

      EventPattern:

      Targets:

          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:

    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:

      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'

# **A policy changed. Which procedure steps are wrong now?**

![ci](https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharathbuilds/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)

> Policies are source code. Procedures are compiled artifacts. Amendments are commits.
> ProcessPatch finds the people or cases that prove a procedure is stale, patches the affected logic, reruns regression tests, and requires human approval of exact artifact hashes before anything changes.

```
Policy change
     ↓
Compile (+ rule review)
     ↓
Witness ("who gets the wrong outcome?")
     ↓
Impact (blast radius from evidence, never estimates)
     ↓
Localized patch
     ↓
Regression tests
     ↓
Certificate → Human approval → New procedure version
```

**Canonical example (synthetic university research grant):** Policy V2 relaxes CGPA
8.0 → 7.5 and makes recommendation required only when CGPA < 8.0. The stale portal
still enforces V1. ProcessPatch returns witness A (CGPA 7.80: expected ELIGIBLE,
portal INELIGIBLE) and witness B (CGPA 8.20: expected rec SKIP, portal REQUIRE),
localizes `NODE-GATE` + `NODE-STEP`, proposes a localized patch, validates 16/16
(witnesses, boundaries, unchanged, ordering, integrity, metamorphic, provenance), quantifies
impact over a 100-case generated cohort, and mints a source-linked certificate.
A second domain (reimbursement: tightened limit, conditional approval, ordering,
deadline) validates 20/20.

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"        # pytest + pyyaml (clean-machine repro)
python scripts/verify.py        # 176 assertions, no network/LLM/AWS
make verify                     # same
make benchmark                  # ProcessPatchBench v0.2.0, 29 scenarios
make infra-validate             # SAM/ASL/dashboard checks, no credentials
python scripts/demo.py          # terminal person-first demo
python -m services.api.server 8000   # REST API (§45 + §57E)
# open frontend/index.html → COMPILE AMENDMENT
```

API highlights: `GET /demo/canonical`, `POST /builds` (idempotent),
`GET /builds/{id}/{diff,witnesses,patch,certificate,impact,guardrails,audit}`,
rule review `POST .../rules/{rid}/{accept,edit,reject,escalate}`,
`POST .../patch/{approve,reject,request-revision}`, witness replay,
`POST /procedures/{v}/activate` (hash-verified), `POST /builds/{id}/resume`
(server-side Step Functions resume — clients never hold task tokens),
benchmark endpoints. The local server and the Lambda `ApiFn` share one
implementation (`services/api/actions.py`) so both surfaces stay identical.

## Layout

`services/` deterministic pipeline + impact/governance/registry/bench/aws_handlers ·
`shared/schemas/` all contracts · `demo/` two domains · `frontend/` 11-tab UI ·
`benchmark/processpatchbench/` 29 heterogeneous cases + manifest ·
`benchmark_runs/` reference runs · `tests/` 8 suites · `infra/` full SAM setup ·
`docs/` 12 notes · `scripts/` verify/demo/benchmark/smoke/infra-validate.

## Trust

A deterministic parser extracts the bounded rule language into typed candidates
with source spans; a Bedrock model fallback engages only when the parser yields
nothing usable (and is schema-validated + Gate-1 reviewed like everything
else). Deterministic code decides correctness. Humans approve exact hashes. Ambiguity → NEEDS_REVIEW, conflict →
COMPILATION BLOCKED. Patches are VALIDATED_WITHIN_TESTED_MODEL, never
"compliance guaranteed".

> Software gets regression tests when code changes. Real-world procedures should get them when rules change.
