    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

  # ---------------- Frontend ----------------
  FrontendApp:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::App
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      Repository: !Ref GitHubRepo
      AccessToken: !Ref AmplifyAccessToken
      EnvironmentVariables:
        - Name: API_URL
          Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
      BuildSpec: |
        version: 1
        frontend:
          phases:
            preBuild:
              commands:
                - echo "window.PROCESSPATCH_API=\"${API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}\";" > frontend/config.js
            build:
              commands: []
          artifacts:
            baseDirectory: frontend
            files:
              - '**/*'
          cache:
            paths: []

  FrontendBranch:
    Type: AWS::Amplify::Branch
    Properties:
      AppId: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId
      BranchName: !Ref AmplifyBranch
      EnableAutoBuild: true

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
  RegistryTable:
    Value: !Ref RegistryTable
  SourceBucket:
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  DashboardName:
    Value: !Ref Dashboard
  AmplifyAppId:
    Value: !GetAtt FrontendApp.AppId

The smoke test only verified the API. The first real Step Functions execution exposed another cloud-path issue: the state machine expected `policy_s3_key`, but the API did not pass the required context.

Fixed and validated:

- API uploads policy evidence to S3.
- API passes policy, procedure, and old rules to Step Functions.
- `GovernFn` receives the complete build context.
- Full tests: `25/25` passed.
- Infrastructure validation: passed.
- SAM build: passed.
- CloudFormation validation: passed.

Redeploy:

```powershell
$python312 = "C:\Users\ayush\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312"
$env:Path = "$python312;$python312\Scripts;$env:Path"

$env:AWS_PROFILE = "processpatch"
$env:AWS_REGION = "ap-south-1"
$env:AWS_DEFAULT_REGION = "ap-south-1"

.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

Then run smoke again:

```powershell
.\scripts\smoke.ps1 `
  -Api "https://ssv1hifpvl.execute-api.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/prod"
```

After smoke passes, start a fresh cloud execution:

```powershell
$api = "https://ssv1hifpvl.execute-api.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/prod"

$b = Invoke-RestMethod `
  -Method Post `
  -Uri "$api/builds" `
  -ContentType "application/json" `
  -Body '{"domain":"research_grant","force":true}'

$e = Invoke-RestMethod `
  -Method Post `
  -Uri "$api/builds/$($b.build_id)/execute" `
  -ContentType "application/json" `
  -Body '{}'

$e
```

Then check the execution:

```powershell
aws stepfunctions describe-execution `
  --execution-arn $e.executionArn `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query 'status' `
  --output text
```

Expected initial result:

```text
RUNNING
```

The previous failed execution can be ignored; use a fresh execution ARN after redeployment.

```text
1    SUCCEED
```

```text
Unable to assume specified IAM Role
```

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.
  AmplifyServiceRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing IAM role ARN for Amplify builds. The role must trust amplify.amazonaws.com.

Conditions:
  HasAmplifyServiceRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AmplifyServiceRoleArn, '']]

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]

    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:

        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:

      EvaluationPeriods: 1

            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ProcessPatch AWS deploy (SAM). See docs/deployment-runbook.md.
# NOTE: `sam deploy --parameter-overrides` takes explicit
# ParameterKey=...,ParameterValue=... pairs (NOT file://...), so we expand
# infra/parameters.json with stdlib python (no jq dependency).
set -euo pipefail
STACK="${STACK:-processpatch-demo}"
REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-south-1}"
PARAMS="$(dirname "$0")/parameters.json"

command -v sam >/dev/null || { echo "install AWS SAM CLI first"; exit 1; }
command -v aws >/dev/null || { echo "install AWS CLI first"; exit 1; }
[ -n "${AMPLIFY_TOKEN:-}" ] || { echo "export AMPLIFY_TOKEN (GitHub token for Amplify hosting) first"; exit 1; }
[ -n "${AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN:-}" ] || { echo "export AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN (existing IAM role ARN for Amplify) first"; exit 1; }

OVERRIDES=$(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(f\"ParameterKey={k},ParameterValue={v}\" for k,v in json.load(open('$PARAMS')).items()))")
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
sam build --template-file infra/template.yaml
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
sam deploy --stack-name "$STACK" --region "$REGION" --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameter-overrides $OVERRIDES ParameterKey=AmplifyAccessToken,ParameterValue="$AMPLIFY_TOKEN" ParameterKey=AmplifyServiceRoleArn,ParameterValue="$AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN" \
  --resolve-s3 --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

API=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name "$STACK" --region "$REGION" \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text)
if [ -z "$API" ] || [ "$API" = "None" ]; then
  echo "CloudFormation returned no ApiUrl; deployment did not complete successfully" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "API: $API"
bash scripts/smoke.sh "$API"

The repeated IAM error is from Amplify’s role assumption, not your buildspec. The CloudFormation-created role is valid on paper but Amplify still refuses it.

I changed deployment to require an externally created Amplify role.

## Create the role manually

AWS Console:

1. Open **IAM → Roles**.
2. Choose **Create role**.
3. Trusted entity: **AWS service**.
4. Select **Amplify** if available.
5. Attach:

```text
AdministratorAccess-Amplify
```

6. Role name:

```text
processpatch-amplify-build
```

If Amplify is not available in the service list, use this custom trust policy:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "Service": "amplify.amazonaws.com"
      },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

Get the role ARN:

```powershell
$env:AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role `
  --role-name processpatch-amplify-build `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query "Role.Arn" `
  --output text

$env:AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN
```

It should look like:

```text
arn:aws:iam::262786914860:role/processpatch-amplify-build
```

Then redeploy:

```powershell
.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

The deployment scripts now pass this ARN explicitly to Amplify.

After deployment succeeds, start a new build. Job `3` can be ignored:

```powershell
aws amplify start-job `
  --app-id d1cldedhl70hud `
  --branch-name main `
  --job-type RELEASE `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

This should create job `4`. Check it:

```powershell
aws amplify get-job `
  --app-id d1cldedhl70hud `
  --branch-name main `
  --job-id 4 `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query "job.steps.[stepName,status]" `
  --output table
```

The template and scripts validate successfully with this change.

toolCallRounds.response:
The repeated IAM error is from Amplify’s role assumption, not your buildspec. The CloudFormation-created role is valid on paper but Amplify still refuses it.

I changed deployment to require an externally created Amplify role.

## Create the role manually

AWS Console:

1. Open **IAM → Roles**.
2. Choose **Create role**.
3. Trusted entity: **AWS service**.
4. Select **Amplify** if available.
5. Attach:

```text
AdministratorAccess-Amplify
```

6. Role name:

```text
processpatch-amplify-build
```

If Amplify is not available in the service list, use this custom trust policy:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "Service": "amplify.amazonaws.com"
      },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

Get the role ARN:

```powershell
$env:AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role `
  --role-name processpatch-amplify-build `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query "Role.Arn" `
  --output text

$env:AMPLIFY_SERVICE_ROLE_ARN
```

It should look like:

```text
arn:aws:iam::262786914860:role/processpatch-amplify-build
```

Then redeploy:

```powershell
.\infra\deploy.ps1 `
  -Stack processpatch-demo `
  -Region ap-south-1
```

The deployment scripts now pass this ARN explicitly to Amplify.

After deployment succeeds, start a new build. Job `3` can be ignored:

```powershell
aws amplify start-job `
  --app-id d1cldedhl70hud `
  --branch-name main `
  --job-type RELEASE `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

This should create job `4`. Check it:

```powershell
aws amplify get-job `
  --app-id d1cldedhl70hud `
  --branch-name main `
  --job-id 4 `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query "job.steps.[stepName,status]" `
  --output table
```

The template and scripts validate successfully with this change.

        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:

    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }

      Policies:

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:

"""Local AWS-IaC validation (no credentials needed).

Checks: template.yaml parses + required resources/policies/substitutions;
statemachine.asl.json parses + state graph integrity + handler existence;
dashboard JSON parses. Run: make infra-validate
"""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INFRA = ROOT / "infra"
ok = True


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global ok
    print(f"  {'PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail if not cond else ''}")
    if not cond:
        ok = False


def main():
    import yaml

    class CfnLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
        pass

    def _cfn(loader, tag_suffix, node):
        if isinstance(node, yaml.ScalarNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_scalar(node)}
        if isinstance(node, yaml.SequenceNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_sequence(node)}
        return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_mapping(node)}

    for tag in ("Ref", "Sub", "GetAtt", "Join", "Select", "If", "Equals",
                "FindInMap", "ImportValue", "Transform"):
        CfnLoader.add_constructor(f"!{tag}", lambda l, n, t=tag: _cfn(l, t, n))
    CfnLoader.add_multi_constructor("!", lambda l, s, n: _cfn(l, s, n))
    tpl = yaml.load((INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text(), Loader=CfnLoader)
    res = tpl.get("Resources", {})
    for name in ("SourceBucket", "ArtifactBucket", "RegistryTable", "Api", "ApiFn",
                 "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn",
                 "GovernFn", "BuildStateMachine", "StateMachineLogs", "NewPolicyEventRule",
                 "EventBridgeToSfnRole", "ExecutionsFailedAlarm", "FunctionErrorsAlarm",
                 "Dashboard"):
        check(f"resource {name}", name in res)
    tbl = res["RegistryTable"]["Properties"]
    check("dynamodb on-demand", tbl.get("BillingMode") == "PAY_PER_REQUEST")
    check("dynamodb PITR", tbl["PointInTimeRecoverySpecification"]["PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled"] is True)
    check("GSI1 for idempotency", any(i["IndexName"] == "GSI1" for i in tbl["GlobalSecondaryIndexes"]))
    check("source bucket private", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["PublicAccessBlockConfiguration"]["BlockPublicAcls"] is True)
    check("source bucket versioned", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["VersioningConfiguration"]["Status"] == "Enabled")
    check("source bucket eventbridge", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["NotificationConfiguration"]["EventBridgeConfiguration"]["EventBridgeEnabled"] is True)
    check("storage=dynamodb env", "PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE" in str(tpl))
    for fn in ("ApiFn", "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn", "GovernFn"):
        h = res[fn]["Properties"]["Handler"]
        mod, func = h.rsplit(".", 1)
        mod = mod.replace(".", "/") + ".py"
        check(f"handler file {h}", (ROOT / mod).exists())
        check(f"handler fn {func}", f"def {func}(" in (ROOT / mod).read_text())
    subs = res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"]["DefinitionSubstitutions"]
    asl_raw = (INFRA / "statemachine.asl.json").read_text()
    for k in subs:
        check(f"ASL substitution {k}", "${" + k + "}" in asl_raw)
    check("sfn logging", "Logging" in res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"])
    check("sfn tracing", res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"].get("Tracing", {}).get("Enabled") is True)

    sm = json.loads(asl_raw)
    states = sm["States"]
    check("asl StartAt exists", sm["StartAt"] in states)
    order = list(states)
    check("asl LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT first", order[1] == "LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT", str(order[:3]))
    check("asl accepted-rules default on happy path", "SET_ACCEPTED_DEFAULT" in states)
    check("asl idempotency gate", "CHECK_IDEMPOTENT" in states and "READY_CACHED" in states)
    check("asl impact AFTER validation",
          order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") > order.index("CHECK_VALIDATION")
          and order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") < order.index("WAIT_FOR_PATCH_APPROVAL"))
    check("asl GovernFn loads context (S3+registry)",
          "load_context" in asl_raw and "find_by_key" in asl_raw)    # graph walk: every Next/Choice target + Default must exist; terminals checked
    refs = set()
    for name, st in states.items():
        if "Next" in st:
            refs.add(st["Next"])
        if st.get("Type") == "Choice":
            for c in st.get("Choices", []):
                refs.add(c["Next"])
            if "Default" in st:
                refs.add(st["Default"])
    check("asl all refs resolve", refs <= set(states), str(refs - set(states)))
    terms = [n for n, s in states.items() if s.get("Type") in ("Succeed", "Fail") or s.get("End")]
    check("asl has terminals", len(terms) >= 3, str(terms))
    gov = [n for n in states if "APPROVAL" in n or "REVIEW" in n or "ACTIVAT" in n]
    check("asl governance gates", len(gov) >= 6, str(gov))
    tokens = sum("waitForTaskToken" in json.dumps(s) for s in states.values())
    check("asl task-token waits", tokens >= 3, str(tokens))
    fns = re.findall(r"\$\{(\w+FnArn)\}", asl_raw)
    check("asl fn refs subset of substitutions", set(fns) <= set(subs), str(set(fns) - set(subs)))

    dash = json.loads((INFRA / "cloudwatch-dashboard.json").read_text())
    check("dashboard widgets", len(dash.get("widgets", [])) >= 5)
    check("dashboard custom namespace", "ProcessPatch" in json.dumps(dash))

    for f in ("deploy.sh", "deploy.ps1"):
        check(f"deploy script {f}", (INFRA / f).exists())
    for bad in ("file://infra/parameters", "file://\"$PARAMS\"", "file://infra"):
        check("deploy avoids file:// params quirk", bad not in (INFRA / "deploy.sh").read_text(), bad)
    check("deploy requires AMPLIFY_TOKEN", "AMPLIFY_TOKEN" in (INFRA / "deploy.sh").read_text())
    check("parameters.json", (INFRA / "parameters.json").exists())
    print("INFRA-VALIDATE", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# ProcessPatch AWS deploy (PowerShell). See docs/deployment-runbook.md.
# NOTE: `sam deploy --parameter-overrides` takes explicit
# ParameterKey=...,ParameterValue=... pairs (NOT file://...).
param([string]$Stack = "processpatch-demo", [string]$Region = "ap-south-1")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not (Get-Command sam -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "install AWS SAM CLI first" }
if (-not (Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "install AWS CLI first" }
$pairs = (Get-Content infra/parameters.json | ConvertFrom-Json).PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { "ParameterKey=$($_.Name),ParameterValue=$($_.Value)" }
sam build --template-file infra/template.yaml
sam deploy --stack-name $Stack --region $Region --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM `
  --parameter-overrides @pairs `
  --resolve-s3 `
  --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "SAM deployment failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
$api = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name $Stack --region $Region `
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text
if (-not $api -or $api -eq "None") { throw "CloudFormation returned no ApiUrl; deployment did not complete successfully" }
Write-Output "API: $api"
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/smoke.ps1 -Api $api

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ProcessPatch AWS deploy (SAM). See docs/deployment-runbook.md.
# NOTE: `sam deploy --parameter-overrides` takes explicit
# ParameterKey=...,ParameterValue=... pairs (NOT file://...), so we expand
# infra/parameters.json with stdlib python (no jq dependency).
set -euo pipefail
STACK="${STACK:-processpatch-demo}"
REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-south-1}"
PARAMS="$(dirname "$0")/parameters.json"

command -v sam >/dev/null || { echo "install AWS SAM CLI first"; exit 1; }
command -v aws >/dev/null || { echo "install AWS CLI first"; exit 1; }

OVERRIDES=$(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(f\"ParameterKey={k},ParameterValue={v}\" for k,v in json.load(open('$PARAMS')).items()))")
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
sam build --template-file infra/template.yaml
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
sam deploy --stack-name "$STACK" --region "$REGION" --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameter-overrides $OVERRIDES \
  --resolve-s3 --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

API=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name "$STACK" --region "$REGION" \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text)
if [ -z "$API" ] || [ "$API" = "None" ]; then
  echo "CloudFormation returned no ApiUrl; deployment did not complete successfully" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "API: $API"
bash scripts/smoke.sh "$API"

"""Local AWS-IaC validation (no credentials needed).

Checks: template.yaml parses + required resources/policies/substitutions;
statemachine.asl.json parses + state graph integrity + handler existence;
dashboard JSON parses. Run: make infra-validate
"""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INFRA = ROOT / "infra"
ok = True


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global ok
    print(f"  {'PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail if not cond else ''}")
    if not cond:
        ok = False


def main():
    import yaml

    class CfnLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
        pass

    def _cfn(loader, tag_suffix, node):
        if isinstance(node, yaml.ScalarNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_scalar(node)}
        if isinstance(node, yaml.SequenceNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_sequence(node)}
        return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_mapping(node)}

    for tag in ("Ref", "Sub", "GetAtt", "Join", "Select", "If", "Equals",
                "FindInMap", "ImportValue", "Transform"):
        CfnLoader.add_constructor(f"!{tag}", lambda l, n, t=tag: _cfn(l, t, n))
    CfnLoader.add_multi_constructor("!", lambda l, s, n: _cfn(l, s, n))
    tpl = yaml.load((INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text(), Loader=CfnLoader)
    res = tpl.get("Resources", {})
    for name in ("SourceBucket", "ArtifactBucket", "RegistryTable", "Api", "ApiFn",
                 "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn",
                 "GovernFn", "BuildStateMachine", "StateMachineLogs", "NewPolicyEventRule",
                 "EventBridgeToSfnRole", "ExecutionsFailedAlarm", "FunctionErrorsAlarm",
                 "Dashboard"):
        check(f"resource {name}", name in res)
    tbl = res["RegistryTable"]["Properties"]
    check("dynamodb on-demand", tbl.get("BillingMode") == "PAY_PER_REQUEST")
    check("dynamodb PITR", tbl["PointInTimeRecoverySpecification"]["PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled"] is True)
    check("GSI1 for idempotency", any(i["IndexName"] == "GSI1" for i in tbl["GlobalSecondaryIndexes"]))
    check("source bucket private", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["PublicAccessBlockConfiguration"]["BlockPublicAcls"] is True)
    check("source bucket versioned", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["VersioningConfiguration"]["Status"] == "Enabled")
    check("source bucket eventbridge", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["NotificationConfiguration"]["EventBridgeConfiguration"]["EventBridgeEnabled"] is True)
    check("storage=dynamodb env", "PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE" in str(tpl))
    for fn in ("ApiFn", "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn", "GovernFn"):
        h = res[fn]["Properties"]["Handler"]
        mod, func = h.rsplit(".", 1)
        mod = mod.replace(".", "/") + ".py"
        check(f"handler file {h}", (ROOT / mod).exists())
        check(f"handler fn {func}", f"def {func}(" in (ROOT / mod).read_text())
    subs = res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"]["DefinitionSubstitutions"]
    asl_raw = (INFRA / "statemachine.asl.json").read_text()
    for k in subs:
        check(f"ASL substitution {k}", "${" + k + "}" in asl_raw)
    check("sfn logging", "Logging" in res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"])
    check("sfn tracing", res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"].get("Tracing", {}).get("Enabled") is True)

    sm = json.loads(asl_raw)
    states = sm["States"]
    check("asl StartAt exists", sm["StartAt"] in states)
    order = list(states)
    check("asl LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT first", order[1] == "LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT", str(order[:3]))
    check("asl accepted-rules default on happy path", "SET_ACCEPTED_DEFAULT" in states)
    check("asl idempotency gate", "CHECK_IDEMPOTENT" in states and "READY_CACHED" in states)
    check("asl impact AFTER validation",
          order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") > order.index("CHECK_VALIDATION")
          and order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") < order.index("WAIT_FOR_PATCH_APPROVAL"))
    check("asl GovernFn loads context (S3+registry)",
          "load_context" in asl_raw and "find_by_key" in asl_raw)    # graph walk: every Next/Choice target + Default must exist; terminals checked
    refs = set()
    for name, st in states.items():
        if "Next" in st:
            refs.add(st["Next"])
        if st.get("Type") == "Choice":
            for c in st.get("Choices", []):
                refs.add(c["Next"])
            if "Default" in st:
                refs.add(st["Default"])
    check("asl all refs resolve", refs <= set(states), str(refs - set(states)))
    terms = [n for n, s in states.items() if s.get("Type") in ("Succeed", "Fail") or s.get("End")]
    check("asl has terminals", len(terms) >= 3, str(terms))
    gov = [n for n in states if "APPROVAL" in n or "REVIEW" in n or "ACTIVAT" in n]
    check("asl governance gates", len(gov) >= 6, str(gov))
    tokens = sum("waitForTaskToken" in json.dumps(s) for s in states.values())
    check("asl task-token waits", tokens >= 3, str(tokens))
    fns = re.findall(r"\$\{(\w+FnArn)\}", asl_raw)
    check("asl fn refs subset of substitutions", set(fns) <= set(subs), str(set(fns) - set(subs)))

    dash = json.loads((INFRA / "cloudwatch-dashboard.json").read_text())
    check("dashboard widgets", len(dash.get("widgets", [])) >= 5)
    check("dashboard custom namespace", "ProcessPatch" in json.dumps(dash))

    for f in ("deploy.sh", "deploy.ps1"):
        check(f"deploy script {f}", (INFRA / f).exists())
    for bad in ("file://infra/parameters", "file://\"$PARAMS\"", "file://infra"):
        check("deploy avoids file:// params quirk", bad not in (INFRA / "deploy.sh").read_text(), bad)
    check("parameters.json", (INFRA / "parameters.json").exists())
    print("INFRA-VALIDATE", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

The result is expected.

```text
PATCH_VALIDATED
16/16 patch checks
Review: REVIEW_PENDING
```

This means the machine validation passed, but the three Rule Gate 1 reviews still need human approval. It does not mean deployment failed.

For GitHub auto-deployment: **currently, no**.

I checked the current Amplify app:

- Branch

: auto-build enabled
- App-level auto-build: disabled
- No webhook was listed

So a GitHub push will not currently trigger an automatic Amplify deployment. Manual builds work with:

```powershell
aws amplify start-job `
  --app-id d1bq8os9dwj0d `
  --branch-name main `
  --job-type RELEASE `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

To enable app-level auto-build:

```powershell
aws amplify update-app `
  --app-id d1bq8os9dwj0d `
  --enable-branch-auto-build `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch
```

Then verify:

```powershell
aws amplify get-app `
  --app-id d1bq8os9dwj0d `
  --region ap-south-1 `
  --profile processpatch `
  --query "app.enableBranchAutoBuild"
```

Expected:

```text
True
```

A GitHub push will then trigger a frontend build only if Amplify’s GitHub webhook is connected. The frontend deployment and backend SAM deployment remain separate. A push to GitHub does not automatically redeploy the AWS backend stack.

whats the usecase of the new iam role
</userRequest>

toolCallRounds.response:
The new IAM role is for **GitHub Actions to deploy your AWS backend automatically**.

Flow:

```text
Push to GitHub main
→ GitHub Actions runs tests
→ GitHub assumes the AWS deployment role via OIDC
→ SAM deploys Lambda/API/Step Functions/DynamoDB/S3 changes
→ Smoke test runs
```

It is separate from:

- `processpatch-amplify-build`: frontend Amplify build role
- `ProcessPatchDeployment`: your local AWS SSO role

The GitHub Actions role avoids storing permanent AWS access keys in GitHub. Its trust policy should allow only:

```text
Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds
main branch
```

The secret stored in GitHub is only the role ARN:

```text
AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN
```

The role needs permission to deploy CloudFormation/SAM resources. For initial setup, `AdministratorAccess` works, but it should be replaced later with a least-privilege deployment policy.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.
  AmplifyServiceRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing IAM role ARN for Amplify builds. The role must trust amplify.amazonaws.com.

Conditions:
  HasAmplifyServiceRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AmplifyServiceRoleArn, '']]

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- Auth (Cognito; see docs/auth.md) ----------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - { Name: verified_email, Priority: 1 }
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  # Invite-only governance: admins approve/activate, reviewers review rules and
  # patches, everyone else is read-only. No self-signup.
  AdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-admins
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May approve candidates and activate procedure versions (Gates 2/3).

  ReviewersGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-reviewers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May review rules (Gate 1) and decide patches (Gate 2).

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}'  # hosted UI prefix; globally unique
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: processpatch-web
      GenerateSecret: false  # public client; PKCE (no implicit flow)
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows: [ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: [code]
      AllowedOAuthScopes: [openid, email]
      SupportedIdentityProviders: [COGNITO]
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendOrigin}/'
        - 'http://localhost:8000/'
      AccessTokenValidity: 8
      IdTokenValidity: 8
      TokenValidityUnits: { AccessToken: hours, IdToken: hours }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Auth:
        # JWT authorizer on every route; public paths opt out per-route below
        # (health, canonical demo build, auth config). See docs/auth.md.
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        AddDefaultAuthorizerToCorsOptions: false
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            AuthorizationScopes: [openid, email]
            JwtConfig:
              Audience: [!Ref WebClient]
              Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          PROCESSPATCH_AUTH: cognito
          PP_USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          PP_CLIENT_ID: !Ref WebClient
          PP_AUTH_DOMAIN: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }
        Canonical:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /demo/canonical, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }
        AuthConfig:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /auth/config, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:

# NOTE: `sam deploy --parameter-overrides` takes explicit
# ParameterKey=...,ParameterValue=... pairs (NOT file://...).
param([string]$Stack = "processpatch-demo", [string]$Region = "ap-south-1")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not (Get-Command sam -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "install AWS SAM CLI first" }
if (-not (Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "install AWS CLI first" }
$pairs = (Get-Content infra/parameters.json | ConvertFrom-Json).PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { "ParameterKey=$($_.Name),ParameterValue=$($_.Value)" }
sam build --template-file infra/template.yaml
sam deploy --stack-name $Stack --region $Region --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM `
  --parameter-overrides @pairs `
  --resolve-s3 `
  --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "SAM deployment failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
$api = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name $Stack --region $Region `
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text
if (-not $api -or $api -eq "None") { throw "CloudFormation returned no ApiUrl; deployment did not complete successfully" }
