powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/smoke.ps1 -Api $api

"""Local AWS-IaC validation (no credentials needed).

Checks: template.yaml parses + required resources/policies/substitutions;
statemachine.asl.json parses + state graph integrity + handler existence;
dashboard JSON parses. Run: make infra-validate
"""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INFRA = ROOT / "infra"
ok = True


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global ok
    print(f"  {'PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail if not cond else ''}")
    if not cond:
        ok = False


def main():
    import yaml

    class CfnLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
        pass

    def _cfn(loader, tag_suffix, node):
        if isinstance(node, yaml.ScalarNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_scalar(node)}
        if isinstance(node, yaml.SequenceNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_sequence(node)}
        return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_mapping(node)}

    for tag in ("Ref", "Sub", "GetAtt", "Join", "Select", "If", "Equals",
                "FindInMap", "ImportValue", "Transform"):
        CfnLoader.add_constructor(f"!{tag}", lambda l, n, t=tag: _cfn(l, t, n))
    CfnLoader.add_multi_constructor("!", lambda l, s, n: _cfn(l, s, n))
    tpl = yaml.load((INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text(), Loader=CfnLoader)
    res = tpl.get("Resources", {})
    for name in ("SourceBucket", "ArtifactBucket", "RegistryTable", "Api", "ApiFn",
                 "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn",
                 "GovernFn", "BuildStateMachine", "StateMachineLogs", "NewPolicyEventRule",
                 "Dashboard", "UserPool", "UserPoolDomain", "WebClient"):
        check(f"resource {name}", name in res)
    tbl = res["RegistryTable"]["Properties"]
    check("dynamodb on-demand", tbl.get("BillingMode") == "PAY_PER_REQUEST")
    check("dynamodb PITR", tbl["PointInTimeRecoverySpecification"]["PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled"] is True)
    check("GSI1 for idempotency", any(i["IndexName"] == "GSI1" for i in tbl["GlobalSecondaryIndexes"]))
    check("source bucket private", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["PublicAccessBlockConfiguration"]["BlockPublicAcls"] is True)
    check("source bucket versioned", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["VersioningConfiguration"]["Status"] == "Enabled")
    check("source bucket eventbridge", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["NotificationConfiguration"]["EventBridgeConfiguration"]["EventBridgeEnabled"] is True)
    check("storage=dynamodb env", "PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE" in str(tpl))
    # --- auth (Cognito): see docs/auth.md ---------------------------------
    tpl_raw = (INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text()
    api_auth = res["Api"]["Properties"].get("Auth", {})
    check("api default authorizer is Cognito JWT",
          api_auth.get("DefaultAuthorizer") == "CognitoAuthorizer" and "JwtConfig" in str(api_auth))
    noauth = str(res["ApiFn"]["Properties"].get("Events", {}))
    for pub in ("/demo/canonical", "/auth/config"):
        check(f"public route {pub} (NO_AUTH)", pub in noauth and "NO_AUTH" in noauth)
    apifn_env = res["ApiFn"]["Properties"]["Environment"]["Variables"]
    check("apifn auth=cognito", apifn_env.get("PROCESSPATCH_AUTH") == "cognito")
    check("apifn pool+client wired",
          apifn_env.get("PP_USER_POOL_ID") == {"Ref": "UserPool"} and apifn_env.get("PP_CLIENT_ID") == {"Ref": "WebClient"})
    check("cognito client is public PKCE (no secret)",
          res["WebClient"]["Properties"].get("GenerateSecret") is False
          and res["WebClient"]["Properties"].get("AllowedOAuthFlows") == ["code"])
    check("governance groups defined", "pp-admins" in tpl_raw and "pp-reviewers" in tpl_raw)
    check("cors allows Authorization header", "Authorization" in str(res["Api"]["Properties"].get("CorsConfiguration", {})))
    for out in ("UserPoolId", "UserPoolClientId", "AuthDomain"):
        check(f"output {out}", out in str(tpl.get("Outputs", {})))
    for fn in ("ApiFn", "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn", "GovernFn"):
        h = res[fn]["Properties"]["Handler"]
        mod, func = h.rsplit(".", 1)
        mod = mod.replace(".", "/") + ".py"
        check(f"handler file {h}", (ROOT / mod).exists())
        check(f"handler fn {func}", f"def {func}(" in (ROOT / mod).read_text())
    subs = res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"]["DefinitionSubstitutions"]
    asl_raw = (INFRA / "statemachine.asl.json").read_text()
    for k in subs:
        check(f"ASL substitution {k}", "${" + k + "}" in asl_raw)
    check("sfn logging", "Logging" in res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"])
    check("sfn tracing", res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"].get("Tracing", {}).get("Enabled") is True)

    sm = json.loads(asl_raw)
    states = sm["States"]
    check("asl StartAt exists", sm["StartAt"] in states)
    order = list(states)
    check("asl LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT first", order[1] == "LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT", str(order[:3]))
    check("asl accepted-rules default on happy path", "SET_ACCEPTED_DEFAULT" in states)
    check("asl idempotency gate", "CHECK_IDEMPOTENT" in states and "READY_CACHED" in states)
    check("asl impact AFTER validation",
          order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") > order.index("CHECK_VALIDATION")
          and order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") < order.index("WAIT_FOR_PATCH_APPROVAL"))
    check("asl GovernFn loads context (S3+registry)",
          "load_context" in asl_raw and "find_by_key" in asl_raw)    # graph walk: every Next/Choice target + Default must exist; terminals checked
    refs = set()
    for name, st in states.items():
        if "Next" in st:
            refs.add(st["Next"])
        if st.get("Type") == "Choice":
            for c in st.get("Choices", []):
                refs.add(c["Next"])
            if "Default" in st:
                refs.add(st["Default"])
    check("asl all refs resolve", refs <= set(states), str(refs - set(states)))
    terms = [n for n, s in states.items() if s.get("Type") in ("Succeed", "Fail") or s.get("End")]
    check("asl has terminals", len(terms) >= 3, str(terms))
    gov = [n for n in states if "APPROVAL" in n or "REVIEW" in n or "ACTIVAT" in n]
    check("asl governance gates", len(gov) >= 6, str(gov))
    tokens = sum("waitForTaskToken" in json.dumps(s) for s in states.values())
    check("asl task-token waits", tokens >= 3, str(tokens))
    fns = re.findall(r"\$\{(\w+FnArn)\}", asl_raw)
    check("asl fn refs subset of substitutions", set(fns) <= set(subs), str(set(fns) - set(subs)))

    dash = json.loads((INFRA / "cloudwatch-dashboard.json").read_text())
    check("dashboard widgets", len(dash.get("widgets", [])) >= 5)
    check("dashboard custom namespace", "ProcessPatch" in json.dumps(dash))

    for f in ("deploy.sh", "deploy.ps1"):
        check(f"deploy script {f}", (INFRA / f).exists())
    for bad in ("file://infra/parameters", "file://\"$PARAMS\"", "file://infra"):
        check("deploy avoids file:// params quirk", bad not in (INFRA / "deploy.sh").read_text(), bad)
    check("parameters.json", (INFRA / "parameters.json").exists())
    print("INFRA-VALIDATE", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.
  AmplifyServiceRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing IAM role ARN for Amplify builds. The role must trust amplify.amazonaws.com.

Conditions:
  HasAmplifyServiceRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AmplifyServiceRoleArn, '']]

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- Auth (Cognito; see docs/auth.md) ----------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - { Name: verified_email, Priority: 1 }
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  # Invite-only governance: admins approve/activate, reviewers review rules and
  # patches, everyone else is read-only. No self-signup.
  AdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-admins
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May approve candidates and activate procedure versions (Gates 2/3).

  ReviewersGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-reviewers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May review rules (Gate 1) and decide patches (Gate 2).

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}'  # hosted UI prefix; globally unique
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: processpatch-web
      GenerateSecret: false  # public client; PKCE (no implicit flow)
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows: [ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: [code]
      AllowedOAuthScopes: [openid, email]
      SupportedIdentityProviders: [COGNITO]
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendOrigin}/'
        - 'http://localhost:8000/'
      AccessTokenValidity: 8
      IdTokenValidity: 8
      TokenValidityUnits: { AccessToken: hours, IdToken: hours }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Auth:
        # JWT authorizer on every route; public paths opt out per-route below
        # (health, canonical demo build, auth config). See docs/auth.md.
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        AddDefaultAuthorizerToCorsOptions: false
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            AuthorizationScopes: [openid, email]
            JwtConfig:
              Audience: [!Ref WebClient]
              Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
          NO_AUTH: {}
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          PROCESSPATCH_AUTH: cognito
          PP_USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          PP_CLIENT_ID: !Ref WebClient
          PP_AUTH_DOMAIN: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }
        Canonical:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /demo/canonical, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }
        AuthConfig:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /auth/config, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NO_AUTH } }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool (invite-only; groups pp-admins/pp-reviewers).
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  AuthDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain (login page lives here).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
  RegistryTable:
    Value: !Ref RegistryTable
  SourceBucket:
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  DashboardName:
    Value: !Ref Dashboard

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.
  AmplifyServiceRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing IAM role ARN for Amplify builds. The role must trust amplify.amazonaws.com.

Conditions:
  HasAmplifyServiceRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AmplifyServiceRoleArn, '']]

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- Auth (Cognito; see docs/auth.md) ----------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - { Name: verified_email, Priority: 1 }
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  # Invite-only governance: admins approve/activate, reviewers review rules and
  # patches, everyone else is read-only. No self-signup.
  AdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-admins
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May approve candidates and activate procedure versions (Gates 2/3).

  ReviewersGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-reviewers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May review rules (Gate 1) and decide patches (Gate 2).

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}'  # hosted UI prefix; globally unique
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: processpatch-web
      GenerateSecret: false  # public client; PKCE (no implicit flow)
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows: [ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: [code]
      AllowedOAuthScopes: [openid, email]
      SupportedIdentityProviders: [COGNITO]
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendOrigin}/'
        - 'http://localhost:8000/'
      AccessTokenValidity: 8
      IdTokenValidity: 8
      TokenValidityUnits: { AccessToken: hours, IdToken: hours }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Auth:
        # JWT authorizer on every route; public paths opt out per-route below
        # (health, canonical demo build, auth config). See docs/auth.md.
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        AddDefaultAuthorizerToCorsOptions: false
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            AuthorizationScopes: [openid, email]
            JwtConfig:
              Audience: [!Ref WebClient]
              Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
          NO_AUTH: {}
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          PROCESSPATCH_AUTH: cognito
          PP_USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          PP_CLIENT_ID: !Ref WebClient
          PP_AUTH_DOMAIN: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }
        Canonical:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /demo/canonical, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }
        AuthConfig:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /auth/config, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool (invite-only; groups pp-admins/pp-reviewers).
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  AuthDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain (login page lives here).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
  RegistryTable:
    Value: !Ref RegistryTable
  SourceBucket:
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  DashboardName:
    Value: !Ref Dashboard

"""Local AWS-IaC validation (no credentials needed).

Checks: template.yaml parses + required resources/policies/substitutions;
statemachine.asl.json parses + state graph integrity + handler existence;
dashboard JSON parses. Run: make infra-validate
"""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INFRA = ROOT / "infra"
ok = True


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global ok
    print(f"  {'PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail if not cond else ''}")
    if not cond:
        ok = False


def main():
    import yaml

    class CfnLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
        pass

    def _cfn(loader, tag_suffix, node):
        if isinstance(node, yaml.ScalarNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_scalar(node)}
        if isinstance(node, yaml.SequenceNode):
            return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_sequence(node)}
        return {tag_suffix: loader.construct_mapping(node)}

    for tag in ("Ref", "Sub", "GetAtt", "Join", "Select", "If", "Equals",
                "FindInMap", "ImportValue", "Transform"):
        CfnLoader.add_constructor(f"!{tag}", lambda l, n, t=tag: _cfn(l, t, n))
    CfnLoader.add_multi_constructor("!", lambda l, s, n: _cfn(l, s, n))
    tpl = yaml.load((INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text(), Loader=CfnLoader)
    res = tpl.get("Resources", {})
    for name in ("SourceBucket", "ArtifactBucket", "RegistryTable", "Api", "ApiFn",
                 "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn",
                 "GovernFn", "BuildStateMachine", "StateMachineLogs", "NewPolicyEventRule",
                 "Dashboard", "UserPool", "UserPoolDomain", "WebClient"):
        check(f"resource {name}", name in res)
    tbl = res["RegistryTable"]["Properties"]
    check("dynamodb on-demand", tbl.get("BillingMode") == "PAY_PER_REQUEST")
    check("dynamodb PITR", tbl["PointInTimeRecoverySpecification"]["PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled"] is True)
    check("GSI1 for idempotency", any(i["IndexName"] == "GSI1" for i in tbl["GlobalSecondaryIndexes"]))
    check("source bucket private", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["PublicAccessBlockConfiguration"]["BlockPublicAcls"] is True)
    check("source bucket versioned", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["VersioningConfiguration"]["Status"] == "Enabled")
    check("source bucket eventbridge", res["SourceBucket"]["Properties"]["NotificationConfiguration"]["EventBridgeConfiguration"]["EventBridgeEnabled"] is True)
    check("storage=dynamodb env", "PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE" in str(tpl))
    # --- auth (Cognito): see docs/auth.md ---------------------------------
    tpl_raw = (INFRA / "template.yaml").read_text()
    api_auth = res["Api"]["Properties"].get("Auth", {})
    check("api default authorizer is Cognito JWT",
          api_auth.get("DefaultAuthorizer") == "CognitoAuthorizer" and "JwtConfig" in str(api_auth))
    noauth = str(res["ApiFn"]["Properties"].get("Events", {}))
    for pub in ("/demo/canonical", "/auth/config"):
        check(f"public route {pub} (NONE)", pub in noauth and "NONE" in noauth)
    apifn_env = res["ApiFn"]["Properties"]["Environment"]["Variables"]
    check("apifn auth=cognito", apifn_env.get("PROCESSPATCH_AUTH") == "cognito")
    check("apifn pool+client wired",
          apifn_env.get("PP_USER_POOL_ID") == {"Ref": "UserPool"} and apifn_env.get("PP_CLIENT_ID") == {"Ref": "WebClient"})
    check("cognito client is public PKCE (no secret)",
          res["WebClient"]["Properties"].get("GenerateSecret") is False
          and res["WebClient"]["Properties"].get("AllowedOAuthFlows") == ["code"])
    check("governance groups defined", "pp-admins" in tpl_raw and "pp-reviewers" in tpl_raw)
    check("cors allows Authorization header", "Authorization" in str(res["Api"]["Properties"].get("CorsConfiguration", {})))
    for out in ("UserPoolId", "UserPoolClientId", "AuthDomain"):
        check(f"output {out}", out in str(tpl.get("Outputs", {})))
    for fn in ("ApiFn", "ExtractorFn", "CompilerFn", "WitnessFn", "ValidatorFn", "ImpactFn", "GovernFn"):
        h = res[fn]["Properties"]["Handler"]
        mod, func = h.rsplit(".", 1)
        mod = mod.replace(".", "/") + ".py"
        check(f"handler file {h}", (ROOT / mod).exists())
        check(f"handler fn {func}", f"def {func}(" in (ROOT / mod).read_text())
    subs = res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"]["DefinitionSubstitutions"]
    asl_raw = (INFRA / "statemachine.asl.json").read_text()
    for k in subs:
        check(f"ASL substitution {k}", "${" + k + "}" in asl_raw)
    check("sfn logging", "Logging" in res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"])
    check("sfn tracing", res["BuildStateMachine"]["Properties"].get("Tracing", {}).get("Enabled") is True)

    sm = json.loads(asl_raw)
    states = sm["States"]
    check("asl StartAt exists", sm["StartAt"] in states)
    order = list(states)
    check("asl LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT first", order[1] == "LOAD_BUILD_CONTEXT", str(order[:3]))
    check("asl accepted-rules default on happy path", "SET_ACCEPTED_DEFAULT" in states)
    check("asl idempotency gate", "CHECK_IDEMPOTENT" in states and "READY_CACHED" in states)
    check("asl impact AFTER validation",
          order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") > order.index("CHECK_VALIDATION")
          and order.index("COMPUTE_IMPACT") < order.index("WAIT_FOR_PATCH_APPROVAL"))
    check("asl GovernFn loads context (S3+registry)",
          "load_context" in asl_raw and "find_by_key" in asl_raw)    # graph walk: every Next/Choice target + Default must exist; terminals checked
    refs = set()
    for name, st in states.items():
        if "Next" in st:
            refs.add(st["Next"])
        if st.get("Type") == "Choice":
            for c in st.get("Choices", []):
                refs.add(c["Next"])
            if "Default" in st:
                refs.add(st["Default"])
    check("asl all refs resolve", refs <= set(states), str(refs - set(states)))
    terms = [n for n, s in states.items() if s.get("Type") in ("Succeed", "Fail") or s.get("End")]
    check("asl has terminals", len(terms) >= 3, str(terms))
    gov = [n for n in states if "APPROVAL" in n or "REVIEW" in n or "ACTIVAT" in n]
    check("asl governance gates", len(gov) >= 6, str(gov))
    tokens = sum("waitForTaskToken" in json.dumps(s) for s in states.values())
    check("asl task-token waits", tokens >= 3, str(tokens))
    fns = re.findall(r"\$\{(\w+FnArn)\}", asl_raw)
    check("asl fn refs subset of substitutions", set(fns) <= set(subs), str(set(fns) - set(subs)))

    dash = json.loads((INFRA / "cloudwatch-dashboard.json").read_text())
    check("dashboard widgets", len(dash.get("widgets", [])) >= 5)
    check("dashboard custom namespace", "ProcessPatch" in json.dumps(dash))

    for f in ("deploy.sh", "deploy.ps1"):
        check(f"deploy script {f}", (INFRA / f).exists())
    for bad in ("file://infra/parameters", "file://\"$PARAMS\"", "file://infra"):
        check("deploy avoids file:// params quirk", bad not in (INFRA / "deploy.sh").read_text(), bad)
    check("parameters.json", (INFRA / "parameters.json").exists())
    print("INFRA-VALIDATE", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  ProcessPatch — Operational Rule Compiler with Counterexample-Guided Procedure
  Repair. Event-driven, serverless, bursty. See docs/aws-setup.md.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Resource suffix (demo, staging, prod).
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: https://github.com/Skullybutcher/Bharatbuilds.git
    Description: Public repo backing the Amplify frontend branch.
  ModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
    Description: >-
      Approved AWS model runtime for semantic-extraction fallback ONLY.
      ap-south-1 reaches Nova Micro via the APAC cross-region inference
      profile; us-east-1 deployments may use amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 directly.
  AmplifyBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: main
  AmplifyAccessToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: GitHub personal access token for Amplify hosting (repo access). Export AMPLIFY_TOKEN locally; never commit it.
  FrontendOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for the API. Keep '*' only for disposable demos; production deployments must set the Amplify URL.
  AmplifyServiceRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing IAM role ARN for Amplify builds. The role must trust amplify.amazonaws.com.

Conditions:
  HasAmplifyServiceRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AmplifyServiceRoleArn, '']]

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 512
    Tracing: Active
    Environment:
      Variables:
        REGISTRY_TABLE: !Ref RegistryTable
        PROCESSPATCH_STORAGE: dynamodb
        PROCESSPATCH_MODEL_FALLBACK: 1
        MODEL_ID: !Ref ModelId
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ---------------- Storage ----------------
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      NotificationConfiguration:
        EventBridgeConfiguration: { EventBridgeEnabled: true }

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { SSEAlgorithm: AES256 }
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: { Status: Enabled }
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldReports
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  RegistryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true }
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - { AttributeName: PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: SK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, AttributeType: S }
        - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, AttributeType: S }
      KeySchema:
        - { AttributeName: PK, KeyType: HASH }
        - { AttributeName: SK, KeyType: RANGE }
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI1
          KeySchema:
            - { AttributeName: GSI_PK, KeyType: HASH }
            - { AttributeName: GSI_SK, KeyType: RANGE }
          Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }

  # ---------------- Auth (Cognito; see docs/auth.md) ----------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - { Name: verified_email, Priority: 1 }
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  # Invite-only governance: admins approve/activate, reviewers review rules and
  # patches, everyone else is read-only. No self-signup.
  AdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-admins
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May approve candidates and activate procedure versions (Gates 2/3).

  ReviewersGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: pp-reviewers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: May review rules (Gate 1) and decide patches (Gate 2).

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}'  # hosted UI prefix; globally unique
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: processpatch-web
      GenerateSecret: false  # public client; PKCE (no implicit flow)
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows: [ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: [code]
      AllowedOAuthScopes: [openid, email]
      SupportedIdentityProviders: [COGNITO]
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendOrigin}/'
        - 'http://localhost:8000/'
      AccessTokenValidity: 8
      IdTokenValidity: 8
      TokenValidityUnits: { AccessToken: hours, IdToken: hours }

  # ---------------- API ----------------
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Auth:
        # JWT authorizer on every route; public paths opt out per-route below
        # (health, canonical demo build, auth config). See docs/auth.md.
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        AddDefaultAuthorizerToCorsOptions: false
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            AuthorizationScopes: [openid, email]
            JwtConfiguration:
              audience: [!Ref WebClient]
              issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: [!Ref FrontendOrigin]
        AllowMethods: ['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS']
        AllowHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization']

  ApiFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.api_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATEMACHINE_ARN: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          PROCESSPATCH_AUTH: cognito
          PP_USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          PP_CLIENT_ID: !Ref WebClient
          PP_AUTH_DOMAIN: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:StartExecution
              Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: states:SendTaskSuccess
              Resource: '*'
              # SendTaskSuccess supports no resource types (service auth reference).
      Events:
        Proxy:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: '/{proxy+}', Method: ANY }
        Health:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }
        Canonical:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /demo/canonical, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }
        AuthConfig:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties: { ApiId: !Ref Api, Path: /auth/config, Method: GET, Auth: { Authorizer: NONE } }

  # ---------------- Pipeline Lambdas ----------------
  ExtractorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.extractor_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${ModelId}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0'

  CompilerFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.compiler_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  WitnessFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.witness_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 1024
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        # NOTE: if Z3 containerization becomes necessary, move this function to
        # PackageType: Image (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deterministic sampling runs here today.

  ValidatorFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.validator_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3WritePolicy: { BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket }

  ImpactFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.impact_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }

  GovernFn:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: services.aws_handlers.govern_handler
      CodeUri: ../
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SOURCE_BUCKET: !Ref SourceBucket
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: { TableName: !Ref RegistryTable }
        - S3ReadPolicy: { BucketName: !Ref SourceBucket }

  # ---------------- Orchestration ----------------
  BuildStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'processpatch-build-${EnvName}'
      DefinitionUri: statemachine.asl.json
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ExtractorFnArn: !GetAtt ExtractorFn.Arn
        CompilerFnArn: !GetAtt CompilerFn.Arn
        WitnessFnArn: !GetAtt WitnessFn.Arn
        ValidatorFnArn: !GetAtt ValidatorFn.Arn
        ImpactFnArn: !GetAtt ImpactFn.Arn
        GovernFnArn: !GetAtt GovernFn.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogs.Arn
      Tracing: { Enabled: true }
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ExtractorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CompilerFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref WitnessFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ValidatorFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ImpactFn
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref GovernFn
        - DynamoDBWritePolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RegistryTable
        - S3WritePolicy:
            BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                - logs:GetLogDelivery
                - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogs.Arn}:*'

  StateMachineLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30

  NewPolicyEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: DISABLED
      Description: >-
        Future event-driven trigger (S3 upload -> build). DISABLED for the
        hackathon: the API starts executions with a complete envelope
        (workspace/procedure/policy ids), which a bare S3 key cannot supply.
      EventPattern:
        source: [aws.s3]
        detail-type: [Object Created]
        detail:
          bucket: { name: [!Ref SourceBucket] }
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref BuildStateMachine
          Id: StartBuild
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToSfnRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: { key: $.detail.object.key }
            InputTemplate: '{"policy_s3_key": <key>}'

  EventBridgeToSfnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: events.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-executions
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref BuildStateMachine

  # ---------------- Observability ----------------
  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-executions-failed'
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref BuildStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  FunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}-lambda-errors'
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'processpatch-${EnvName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# ProcessPatch - compile/test/patch pipeline\nCustom namespace: **ProcessPatch** (CompileRuns, WitnessesFound, NeedsReviewCount, ExtractionFailures, PatchValidationFailures)."}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Step Functions executions", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/States", "ExecutionsStarted", "StateMachineArn", "${BuildStateMachine}"],
                           [".", "ExecutionsSucceeded", ".", "."],
                           [".", "ExecutionsFailed", ".", "."]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Lambda errors + throttles", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "Throttles", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "stat": "Sum", "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Pipeline latency (p50 duration)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", {"stat": "p50"}],
                           ["AWS/States", "ExecutionTime", {"stat": "p50"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Domain metrics (ProcessPatch namespace)", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["ProcessPatch", "CompileRuns", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WitnessesFound", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "NeedsReviewCount", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "PatchValidationFailures", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 24, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "DynamoDB throttles + latency", "region": "${AWS::Region}",
               "metrics": [["AWS/DynamoDB", "ReadThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                           [".", "WriteThrottleEvents", {"stat": "Sum"}]], "period": 300}}
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: HTTP API base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool (invite-only; groups pp-admins/pp-reviewers).
